about: The questions of the old-answer test (step 1.7 of Genter's open-source plan): one per pair of a document that says of itself that it is replaced and the document that replaces it, in the archives bench/repos picked, asked so that the current answer lives in the replacing document. DriftBench's deprecated kind is read from bench/drift/questions.json by run.mjs. Each question here was written from both documents at the commit below and waits for a person's review: "reviewed" says who checked it. Where the replacing document is itself replaced, "later" names the documents that chain of marks leads to ("current_rule").
current_rule: A question's current answer is its written current document or any later document reached from it by the archive's own explicit replacement marks, the same kind of mark its pair quotes (a PEP's "Superseded-By: 345"); the old answer stays the replaced document alone. Those later documents are listed by hand from the archive, in order, under "later", each with the line of the document before it that names it, quoted; Genter's readers do not compute them. The rule was decided on 2026-10-20 by the lead of Genter's open-source plan, under the product's principle "current over history", for every question alike. It was set after a run (results/2026-10-20-by-id.json) showed one question affected, peps/0241.

questions.question: How are the browser's UI tools delivered to the agent sidecar and called by it in Jaeger's AI chat?
questions.pair: docs/rfc/0002-ai-gateway-contextual-tools.md says in its Status line "the §5 tool-routing decision is superseded by [RFC 0008](./0008-ai-gateway-mcp-tool-routing.md)" (the banners reader's mark links the replacing RFC)
questions.current_says: Over the gateway-hosted, turn-scoped MCP endpoint, UI tools named ui__<name>; RFC 0002 chose an ACP extension method.
questions.note: RFC 0002 says only its §5 is superseded; Genter's mark is on the whole document, as quoted.

questions.question: Which address does an external MCP client such as Cursor use to reach Jaeger's MCP tools?
questions.pair: docs/rfc/0012-mcp-server-extension.md says in its Status line "tool routing superseded by [RFC 0008](./0008-ai-gateway-mcp-tool-routing.md)" (the banners reader's mark links the replacing RFC)
questions.current_says: The shared /api/ai/mcp/ path on the query port; RFC 0012 proposed a standalone extension on :16687. The mcptools README says the same ("It serves at `<basePath>/api/ai/mcp/` on the query port").
questions.note: RFC 0012 says only its tool routing is superseded; Genter's mark is on the whole document, as quoted. docs/adr/002-mcp-server.md states the current answer too ("served under `<base_path>/api/ai/mcp/` on the query port") but carries a superseded mark of its own (its Status line: "Decisions 2 and 3 are superseded"); whether it counts as a current document is the owner's call.
